_comment: Null-sec route map around the home station. 'routes' is a list of chains; consecutive
entries in a chain are one jump apart, and the graph is undirected. Every chain starts
at the station, so a system's jump distance is its BFS depth from 'station'.
Used for pod avoidance: after a pod death the system we died in is cut out of the graph
and everything no longer reachable from the station is refused (missions there are
declined at the agent, or quit on undock if the route panel reveals it later).
Systems that keep an alternate path stay allowed — dying in KLY-C0 does not block
ROIR-Y, because J-CIJV => G95-VZ => ROIR-Y still reaches it.
avoid_minutes: how long a podded system stays cut out. 0 = rest of session.
reroute_templates: system -> templates/<name>.png, right-clicked and jumped instead of
the autopilot stargate when the route has to detour around the podded system.
